attempts.text:
Assumptions: roads are two-way. The Tarkeshwar–Likhu bridge is out and the Suryagadhi–Gajuri road is closed, so neither is used. The three flood-affected roads are treated as passable because the report doesn't say they are closed. Those roads are dangerous, so the car should cross them carefully.

Grouping the people by location, the best plan is:
- Send the car to Gajuri for the elderly widow and back to Thakre (14 min).
- Send the car via Myagang, Suryagadhi and Likhu to Panchakanya, then back via Likhu and Suryagadhi to Tarkeshwar hospital (150 min). On the way it picks up the Myagang grandmother, and the two injured and the Panchakanya widow fill the car to four. The route is forced because Panchakanya is reachable only through Likhu.
- Defer the seven Likhu adults. Any trip to Likhu from the hospital costs at least 82 minutes, and carrying four adults saves only 80 in penalties. Deferring all seven (140) is cheaper than any rescue trip for them.
